messages:
sara_pm: Follow-up from the fallback-loop postmortem. Pulled together remediation items — need owners, JIRA, RACI and due dates. Reply: owner / JIRA / RACI (R/A/C/I) / due (YYYY-MM-DD).

Items:
1) Selector race fix (concurrent selector + cold-KV)
2) KV-warmup canary + replay job
3) Latency/fallback playbook + runbook link
4) Billing anomaly detector + temporary throttle
5) CI smoke perf test after deploy
6) Meta analysis: correlation of rollouts with cold-starts over last 60 days

ben_platform: I'll take 2. ben_platform / RI-4001 / R=ben_platform A=platform-lead C=kai_runtime I=eng-all / due: 2026-09-10

anya_sre: I'll own 3 and 6. anya_sre / RI-4002 (playbook) RI-4006 (analysis) / R=anya_sre A=eng-sre C=oncall,kai_runtime I=product / due: 2026-08-30 (3) 2026-09-15 (6)

kai_runtime: I'll pick 1 and 5. kai_runtime / RI-4003 (selector) RI-4005 (CI) / R=kai_runtime A=runtime-lead C=anya_sre I=eng-all / due: 2026-08-20 (1) 2026-08-25 (5)

sara_pm: For 4 I can coordinate with finance but prefer runtime to prototype the throttle flag. nina_finance is OOO next week; tagging kai_runtime to co-own. sara_pm / RI-4004 (coord) / R=sara_pm A=product C=nina_finance,kai_runtime I=finance / due: 2026-09-05

ben_platform: For RI-4001: plan is a replay job that pulls a 3-minute traffic window, warms KV, verifies miss-rate and latency. Est cost ~2 GPU-hours/run. Will add checklist and handoff notes in the ticket.

anya_sre: For RI-4002 I'll draft playbook steps: immediate pin variant, scale pool, disable rollouts, communications template. Will link to incident channel and add runbook hookup.

kai_runtime: For RI-4003 I'll add a small harness to reproduce the race and add a regression in selector CI. Also proposing a rollout gating rule to prevent concurrent selector operations during warmup windows.

sara_pm: ops-bot: create weekly sync starting 2026-08-10 16:00 UTC and ping owners.

ops-bot: Reminder created: "Remediation weekly sync" recurring weekly starting 2026-08-10 16:00 UTC. Notified: ben_platform, anya_sre, kai_runtime, sara_pm.

ben_platform: If platform needs to hand off RI-4001 to runtime after prototype, I'll add an accept/handoff checklist and assign to kai_runtime in the ticket.

anya_sre: I'll own the analysis (RI-4006) and will surface if the pattern is recurring; if so, recommend a 'safe-rollout' orchestrator gate.

sara_pm: Recap: RI-4003= kai_runtime (selector), RI-4001= ben_platform (canary), RI-4002= anya_sre (playbook), RI-4004= sara_pm (coord), RI-4005= kai_runtime (CI), RI-4006= anya_sre (analysis). Everyone add acceptance criteria + test plan in JIRA. Ops-bot will nudge 48h before due. Post here to hand off. Closing thread for now.
